_what: Bounds of the drive tools (read-data/drives.mjs). `icon`: the square sizes in pixels a drive icon may be drawn at, and the size when none is asked. `kinds`: one look at what is on a drive reads at most `most_files` files for at most `most_ms` milliseconds, inside the engine's time for one run; a drive larger than that is answered as far as it was read, with `complete: false`. `largest_kept` is how many of the largest files are named.
_readers: `readers`: the ways a place may know its connected drives, tried in order. A reader is chosen only when its `at` path exists on the place the run is on; the tool never asks what kind of machine it is. `finder-volumes` lists the folders under `volumes_root` that Finder shows, with diskutil's identity, and can draw Finder's icon. `mount-table` reads a kernel mount table (`at`, mountinfo lines) and lists the block-device mounts inside one of `mount_roots`; it has no icon and no safe eject, so its drives answer `ejectable: false`. `lsof` is where that place keeps the program that names open files.
